contract.structural_score_basis: Zellic audits cover the original frxUSD/custodian system and later frxUSD cross-chain components, correcting the prior false unaudited premise. Assurance does not lift the axis above the admin cap: Ethereum's 4-of-7 Safe can mint, administer freezing, freeze, thaw, pause and unpause without delay. Upgrades use a 24h setting reducible by that Safe to a 2h floor. Walked remote OFT deployments expose undelayed peer and upgrade paths under a common 3-of-6 owner set. Audited-commit-to-deployed-code identity is not established across every live deployment.
code_facts: Zellic published a July 2025 Frax review covering frxUSD, FrxUSDCustodian, FraxNetDeposit and RWARedemptionCoordinator, plus a February 2026 frxUSD infrastructure review.

Ethereum authority loop: token owner is Safe 0xffffff4f3bac444b2c0ecf2a1840d018be783937 (4-of-7); EIP-1967 admin is ProxyAdmin 0x0b2c3df006b2bd43cbcc60075e7a0bf314474ed6; its owner is Timelock 0xb898ad2976b4d8f2e21521c9db16b7497825e503.
Timelock delay is 86,400 seconds, minimum delay is 7,200 seconds, and the same 4-of-7 Safe administers it.
The Ethereum Safe can mint, administer freezers, freeze, thaw, pause and unpause without an enforced delay.
Walked L2 OFT deployments permit owner-controlled peer changes; a malicious peer can credit balances without an implementation upgrade.
cross_axis: The enforceable upgrade floor is two hours, not the configured 24 hours.
Reserve composition belongs to Backing and Dependencies; it is not priced again here.
contract.coverage_note: Accepted authority evidence covers eight of the previously declared eleven chains, while Frax Facts now reports supply across more than 30 networks. Unwalked deployments are unmeasured, not clean; closing the gap requires a fresh peer enumeration and hand walk.
contract.coverage_summary: Eight previously declared chains covered; current deployment set exceeds 30 networks and is not exhaustively walked.
contract.provenance_note: Score re-read 2026-10-12. Audit coverage corrected from absent to present; 3.5 held because the admin half caps the axis.
contract.custody_disclosure: The on-chain Safe thresholds are measured. Off-chain custody, operator identity, and signer independence are not publicly established by the sources reviewed, so the report does not infer one person per key or the absence of MPC/HSM controls.
contract.custody_disclosure_sources: Frax documentation and public repositories checked through 2026-10-12; no signing-policy disclosure tied to the admin sets was located.
